source.description: Canonical AIBE question bank for the web app. One canonical set per exam; alternate booklet sets are excluded when they duplicate the same questions.
source.note: Questions/options/answers were extracted from source documents. No subject/topic mappings were inferred.
source.updated: Missing/structurally incomplete source questions recovered and JSON normalized for the web app.
source.notes: AIBE 18-21 added/verified from supplied Set-A papers. Final answer keys used for AIBE 19-21; withdrawn questions remain in the bank with status=withdrawn so historical numbering is preserved.
source.answerPolicy: Use correctAnswer after submission. For withdrawn questions, correctAnswer is null and the question is not scorable.
source.canonicalization: Set A preferred when available. Alternate sets are used only to recover a missing question when the match is high confidence.
